title: Most popular websites based on Tranco rank
hook: Witness the shifting landscape of internet traffic as the web's most popular platforms battle for supremacy over nearly three decades.
setup: Tracking annual metrics reveals the rise of early portal giants, search engine dominance, and the emergence of modern social media networks.

sequence.text: AOL.com debuted at the top of the ranking in 1995 with over 37 million.
Google.com entered the ranking for the first time in the year 2000.
YouTube.com and Facebook.com appeared as newcomers in the ranking by 2007.
Google.com maintained the lead with a value of 88400000000 by 2022.

highlights.headline: Early Portal Era
highlights.detail: AOL.com began as the top-ranked website in 1995.

factBox.heading: AOL Leader
factBox.body: AOL.com held the top position with 37485000 in 1995.

ending: From early dial-up portals to global search and social titans, these decades charted the monumental expansion of the digital world.
